messages:
rachel: quick FYI - small regression found during q3b bring-up: kvcache prefix joins can glue CJK punctuation to following token. repro below.

tao: paste minimal repro?

rachel: repro:
# cold: input: 我今天去商店，买了。 -> output ok
# warm (prefix cached): prefix: 前一次 user: 我今天去商店，买了。 -> observed prefix glued with no ideographic comma before sentence

vikram: can repro on q3b runtime. quick metrics (small set 300): baseline fp16 zh->en BLEU 29.5, q3b cold 29.0, q3b warm 26.8.

tao: tokenization samples show merged token at boundary instead of spacer token. looks like cache concat bypasses tokenizer normalization.

eval-bot: queued full locale sweep: gs://redwood-evals/pioneer-q3b/1764448888/

rachel: short plan: (1) add unit test for prefix+kvcache boundary, (2) try locale-gated re-normalize on cache read as canary, (3) bisect tokenizer/runtime changes last 3 months.

vikram: I tried inserting U+200B between spans: fixes zh spacing but breaks some ja compounds. need locale-aware rule.

tao: agree. if we can't land quick mitigation, pause q3b rollout for these regions.

rachel: I'll file triage ticket w/ examples and link eval artifacts. keep updates here.
